name: ai-ocr-monorepo
description: AI OCR Dashboard - Monorepo with backend services

scripts.dev:backend: mkdir -p logs && cd apps/backend-services && npm run start:dev 2>&1 | tee ../../logs/backend-services.log
scripts.dev:frontend: mkdir -p logs && cd apps/frontend && npm run dev 2>&1 | tee ../../logs/frontend.log
scripts.dev:temporal-worker: mkdir -p logs && cd apps/temporal && npm run dev 2>&1 | tee ../../logs/temporal-worker.log
scripts.dev: mkdir -p logs && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:temporal-worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend-services && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:all: RUN_INTEGRATION=1 npm test --workspaces --if-present && RUN_INFRA=1 npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:db:reset: cd apps/backend-services && PRISMA_USER_CONSENT_FOR_DANGEROUS_AI_ACTION="yes" npx prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed
scripts.generate:openapi: cd apps/backend-services && SSO_AUTH_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:8080/realms/test SSO_REALM=test SSO_CLIENT_ID=test-client SSO_CLIENT_SECRET=test-secret FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000 KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_KEY=dummy-key DATABASE_URL=postgresql://dummy:dummy@localhost:5432/dummy BLOB_STORAGE_TYPE=filesystem BLOB_STORAGE_ROOT=/tmp/uploads TEMPORAL_ADDRESS=localhost:7233 TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE=default TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register ../../docs/generate-openapi.ts
scripts.pod:base: npm run generate:alert-rules && podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile monitoring up -d
scripts.pod:base:build: npm run generate:alert-rules && podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile monitoring up -d --build
scripts.pod:base:down: podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile monitoring down
scripts.pod:all: npm run generate:alert-rules && podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile temporal-worker --profile app --profile monitoring up -d
scripts.pod:all:build: npm run generate:alert-rules && podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile temporal-worker --profile app --profile monitoring up -d --build
scripts.pod:all:down: podman compose --profile infra --profile temporal --profile temporal-worker --profile app --profile monitoring down
scripts.docs:build: npm run generate:openapi && cd docs && bash build.sh

overridesNotes.zustand: Force zustand v5 everywhere. @assistant-ui/* require v5 (they import useShallow from zustand/shallow, which is v5-only), but @xyflow/react pins v4 and npm would otherwise hoist v4 to the top where @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk's transitive @assistant-ui/core resolves it and breaks. The paired @xyflow/react override below keeps v4 scoped to React Flow only.
overridesNotes.@xyflow/react.zustand: Pinned to zustand v4 because React Flow (@xyflow/react) only supports zustand ^4.4; our top-level zustand is v5 for @assistant-ui. REMOVE this override when React Flow ships zustand v5 support (as of @xyflow/react 12.11.0 it still requires ^4.4.0).
